run_f_regression: run f_regression on feature matrix X and target y to compute univariate F-test statistics
run_mutual_info_regression: run mutual_info_regression on feature matrix X and target y to compute mutual information scores
compare_f_test_vs_mi: compare F-test and mutual information scores for feature selection on the same dataset
plot_feature_dependency: plot scatter plots of y against each feature with F-test and MI scores as titles
normalize_feature_scores: normalize F-test and mutual information scores by dividing by their maximum values
